title: execution_permission
description: A bundle's envelope/execution_permission.json: what the lab's confirmed policy lets the built agent run on its own, copied by the Designer from the lab profile the build names, never inferred. The gate reads `reaches`, a value, and no sentence. Levels, each including the one before: none, mock, sandbox, engine, instrument. A tool whose gate opens_by execution_permission runs where `reaches` is engine or instrument; instrument opens no tool that changes an instrument, which stays behind safety values (MP4).

words.description: the confirmed value of the profile, as it stands there
